author: source_route
body:
Here is my first nebula map guys / gals! 
View screen shots here: http://imgur.com/a/r8lfC

The monuments are called left, right
 
Teams are lime and gray
 
Water for sky bridging, Diamonds are located in center, each team has iron in their spawn.

EDITS: all diamond axes located in chests are sharpness I, 3 layers under each island (beside spawn), monuments are further from spawn, less blocks then brick.
